hero.name: Ángel Huamán
hero.bio1: I'm a student exploring the intersection of machine learning, data engineering, and business intelligence. My work focuses on building systems that turn complex data into clear, actionable insights.
hero.bio2: Currently pursuing my degree in Systems Engineering, I'm passionate about open-source tools, statistical modeling, and creating visualizations that tell compelling stories with data.
